description: Change of Use: Residential dwelling (Class C3) to residential children's care home for up to three children aged 10 to 17 (Class C2)
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The proposal would result in the loss of existing residential floorspace and no justification or reprovision has been provided to demonstrate that this loss is acceptable. The development would therefore result in an unwarranted reduction in the Borough’s housing stock, contrary to the relevant provisions in the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies H8A of the London Plan (2021), CS1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), DM24 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and HO1 of the Emerging Harrow’s New Local Plan (Regulation 19 Version).</span></span></p>

<p>Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate&nbsp;the proposal would address&nbsp;an identified local need for the proposed children’s care home and that the development is located within the community is intended to serve would be required. The lack of a legal agreement to secure first refusals for children placements for the London Borough of Harrow would not ensure that the needs of local childcare would be addressed. As such, the proposed change of use would be inappropriate for this site contrary to the relevant provisions of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), , Policies H12 of the London Plan (2021), CS1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), DM29 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and HO7 of the Emerging Harrow’s New Local Plan (Regulation 19 Version).&nbsp;</p>
